# frontend

```go
import "github.com/lucasavila00/tgo/internal/frontend"
```

Package frontend lets the compiler read TGo with Go's parser.

The private Go parser reads \! and \!\! on call expressions. It records the exact operand and operator span. After parsing succeeds, the frontend saves source call names and builds calls for checking. This keeps generated helper names out of error context. Failed attempts reserve no postfix helper names.

Preparation converts if and switch expressions, comprehensions, and short returns to temporary Go syntax and records their meaning. A temporary call represents a value expression; its branches still belong to the enclosing source function. Checking applies TGo rules to these records. Lowering uses them to generate ordinary Go statements.

### Keep source edits and source meaning separate

Each preparation rule returns an edit and its TGo record. One file preparation owns the prepared text, records, and positions. It applies text edits and position changes together. Errors and syntax nodes thus keep the positions of the input, even when a replacement has a different length.

Conditional syntax can be ambiguous with an ordinary Go statement. Its preparation and parser recovery share recognition and replacement rules. Preparation handles clear operands first. If Go parsing fails, recovery can identify another operand and request the same kind of edit. This preserves ordinary Go statement parsing and allows nested TGo forms.

ParseFile returns the completed tree and TGo records together. Type checking and code generation use that result; source preparation does not choose types.

## type Comprehension

Comprehension records a typed collection and its range and filter statements. Output identifies the leaf call that supplies an element or a key and value.

```go
type Comprehension struct {
    Position token.Position
    Type     ast.Expr
    Body     *ast.BlockStmt
    Output   string
    Ranges   []*ast.RangeStmt
}
```

## type Marker

Marker records a postfix operation and its original source position.

```go
type Marker struct {
    Name     string
    Wrap     bool
    CallName string
    Position token.Position
}
```

## type Parsed

Parsed contains Go syntax and records for added TGo forms.

```go
type Parsed struct {
    File           *ast.File
    Comprehensions map[string]*Comprehension
    Conditionals   map[string]token.Position
    Propagations   map[string]Marker
    ShortReturns   map[string]ShortReturn
}
```

### func ParseFile

```go
func ParseFile(fset *token.FileSet, filename, sourceName string, input []byte, used map[string]bool) (*Parsed, error)
```

ParseFile parses added expressions and maps syntax positions to the input. Conditional bodies remain statements in the original enclosing function.

## type ShortReturn

ShortReturn records which results a return statement omits.

```go
type ShortReturn struct {
    ZeroSuccess bool
    Position    token.Position
}
```
